effective_policy.fixture_guard: candidate fixture median slower than baseline median AND at least9/16 paired fixture slowdowns strictly positive rejects
effective_policy.precedence: This final user-directed1% and zero-repeatable-fixture-slowdown policy supersedes earlier2%/3% rules and the positive-only design amendment for this new family. Historical records/outcomes remain unchanged.
